summary: Terra Vedant Tech is a React + TypeScript single-page marketing/landing website for an agriculture technology company. It is built with Vite and Tailwind CSS (CSS-variable/OKLCH design tokens) and uses shadcn-ui style UI primitives. The site is composed of reusable sections (sticky header, hero, about, services, contact, footer) driven by centralized marketing copy modules and static public image assets. The repository also includes Internet Computer (ICP) scaffolding: an Internet Identity authentication provider and a React Query-based backend actor hook, but the Motoko backend canister currently exposes no methods and the contact form submission is simulated client-side.

existing_features.title: Single-page responsive marketing website layout
existing_features.description: Implements a responsive single-page layout composed of a sticky header, hero, about, services, contact sections, and a footer, assembled in frontend/src/App.tsx.

existing_features.title: Centralized marketing copy registry
existing_features.description: Provides structured hero/about/services/contact copy via frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts and renders it across the corresponding UI sections.

existing_features.title: Centralized brand asset paths registry
existing_features.description: Defines consistent logo asset paths (large/standard) via frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts for reuse across the application where needed.

existing_features.title: Sticky responsive header with desktop navigation and mobile menu
existing_features.description: Provides a fixed header that changes styling on scroll, includes desktop navigation links, supports a toggleable mobile menu, and includes a desktop CTA to scroll to the contact section.

existing_features.title: Responsive enlarged header branding image from public assets
existing_features.description: Renders a static uploaded branding image in the header branding area from /assets/IMG_20260205_151716-4.jpg and sizes it responsively (h-16 mobile, h-20 md, h-24 lg) while increasing header min-height to avoid overlap/overflow.

existing_features.title: Smooth scrolling in-page navigation with fixed header offset
existing_features.description: Implements smooth scrolling to section IDs using an offset to account for the fixed header, used by header navigation, hero CTAs, and footer quick links.

existing_features.title: Hero section with background image and primary/secondary CTAs
existing_features.description: Renders a full-screen hero with a static background image, headline/subheadline from centralized copy, and CTAs that smooth-scroll to Contact and Services sections.

existing_features.title: About section with mission text and value cards
existing_features.description: Displays company mission text from centralized copy and a three-card values grid (Sustainability, Innovation, Partnership) with lucide-react icons.

existing_features.title: Services section with icon-mapped offering cards
existing_features.description: Renders a responsive grid of service cards from structured content, mapping service icon keys to lucide-react icons.

existing_features.title: Contact section with contact details and sanitized tel: link
existing_features.description: Displays email (mailto:), address, and phone sourced from centralized content; phone uses a sanitized tel: URI by stripping non-dialable characters except '+'.

existing_features.title: Client-side validated contact form with submission feedback
existing_features.description: Implements name/email/message validation with inline errors, a loading state, and a success message after a simulated submission (client-only).

existing_features.title: Footer with quick links, social icon buttons, and attribution (no logo)
existing_features.description: Provides footer brand text, quick-link buttons that scroll to sections, social icon buttons, and a bottom bar with dynamic year and external attribution; no logo is rendered.

existing_features.title: Tailwind theme tokens and dark-mode-ready styling
existing_features.description: Defines CSS-variable-based theme tokens for light/dark modes and Tailwind configuration including custom fonts, shadows, and animations (e.g., fade-in).

existing_features.title: Static public assets usage for imagery
existing_features.description: Uses absolute-path image references under /assets/... for hero background imagery and header branding image served from the public folder.

existing_features.title: App bootstrap with React Query and auth providers
existing_features.description: Bootstraps the application in frontend/src/main.tsx with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication context (ICP scaffolding)
existing_features.description: Implements an InternetIdentityProvider/useInternetIdentity hook that initializes AuthClient, loads a stored identity on mount when available, and supports login/logout with status and error state.

existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous or authenticated backend actor based on the current identity, caches it via React Query keyed by principal, and invalidates/refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.

architectural_notes: Section-based SPA composition in App.tsx (SiteHeader + sections + SiteFooter).
Centralized content modules (src/content/marketingCopy.ts and src/content/brandAssets.ts) used as a single source of truth for copy and asset paths.
Tailwind CSS theming via CSS variables (OKLCH tokens) with dark mode enabled via class strategy.
UI built using shadcn-ui conventions (Button/Card/Input/Textarea/Alert components) and utility-first Tailwind classes.
In-page navigation implemented with imperative DOM scrolling and a fixed header offset (implemented separately in header/hero/footer).
App bootstrap composes QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider at the root (main.tsx).
Internet Identity authentication implemented via a React Context provider around @dfinity/auth-client, with stored identity loading on mount.
Backend actor creation/caching implemented with @tanstack/react-query, producing anonymous vs authenticated actors keyed by principal.
Static assets served from the public folder and referenced via absolute /assets/... paths for deployment stability.
Backend is present as a Motoko canister placeholder (backend/main.mo) intended for future expansion.
known_issues: Motoko backend (backend/main.mo) is an empty actor; there is currently no backend API for the frontend to call.
ContactForm submission is simulated with setTimeout; no real submission to backend/email/CRM occurs.
Internet Identity provider URL uses process.env.II_URL; Vite typically expects import.meta.env (e.g., VITE_...), so runtime configuration may not work without additional tooling.
Two different global theme token files exist (frontend/index.css and frontend/src/index.css), risking inconsistent styling depending on which is actually bundled/included.
scrollToSection logic is duplicated in multiple components (header/hero/footer) instead of being shared via a utility/hook.
Footer social links are '#' placeholders and not production-ready.
ContactForm heading text is hardcoded instead of using contactContent.formTitle, risking copy drift.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts is an intentional placeholder; no domain React Query hooks are implemented yet.
useActor invalidates and refetches all non-actor React Query queries when the actor changes; this may become expensive as query usage grows.
No automated tests are present in the provided code/files; regressions would be caught only manually.
